name: solidcraft
description: Models and edits parts in SolidCraft, the parametric CAD app open beside Studio, through its MCP server. The engineer edits the same design by hand; the agent reads it first and builds on it.

interface.shortDescription: Edit parts like a CAD tool
interface.longDescription: SolidCraft is a parametric CAD app with sketches, constraints and a feature timeline. With it open beside Studio, the engineer changes dimensions and features by hand and the agent works on the same design through its MCP server.
